claim: Patchline ships an autonomy certification suite scoring the fleet against published maturity criteria. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the autonomy certification claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make autonomy-certification-suite-gate`.
